title: Add bounded named recording sessions
description: Implement recording session [name] with TTY-only prompt, configurable Movies base and named collection/profile/scene/source-filter bindings. Strict preflight without switching OBS configuration or configuring hardware. Reserve non-overwriting dated folder, snapshot all old paths, set program and both source paths before start, restore attempted path changes best effort on failures. Document normal stop/status and unsynchronized pause behavior; preserve unrelated local edits.
acceptance_criteria: Fake-client tests prove preflight rejects active outputs, binding/filter mismatches and read failures before writes; setting/readback/start failures restore attempted old paths and never start with partial configuration; safe names and existing directory/file/symlink collisions never overwrite. Run go build ./..., go test ./..., go vet ./...; build /tmp/obs-cli-session. No live OBS access required.

title: Confirm recording activation before reporting session success
description: Live OBS proof: StartRecord acknowledges asynchronously. Two immediate named-session calls could both succeed and redirect pending recordings into the second directory. Add an activation wait and regressions; retain all paths after any start attempt because the outcome can be uncertain. Validate MKV/main filename and source record_mode=3. Positive proof: delayed fake startup waits; immediate second start rejects; timeout/poll errors preserve paths; live sequential recordings create all three valid MKVs and same-name suffix directories.

title: Adaptive named recording session composition and optional display selection
description: Implement pure screen/fixed-16:9 layout and narrow OBS adapter before session paths/start. Optional display UUID overlay and stable source readiness; keep compatibility. Urgent Source Record lifecycle safety: snapshot all settings/index/enabled, remove both before changed SetVideoSettings, drain graphics queue, reset/layout, restore identical filters before start; best-effort restoration on every failure. Unchanged video must skip detach/reset. No live OBS interaction.
acceptance_criteria: Fake and loopback tests prove aspect/even sizing, portrait and bounded PIP geometry, safe overlay/readiness, idle checks before writes, failures never start, keep compatibility, CLI config defaults/schema. Build/test/vet/race and just checks pass; document flags; exclude user schema-comment change.

title: Ship portable macOS recording launcher with first tagged release
description: Move AppleScript launcher and native Swift display discovery into maintained obs-cli sources; remove user-specific paths; build helper into generated app resources; add safe macOS build/install just recipes and docs; exclude app bundles/config/recordings from git. Validate on macOS by compiling scripts, running display discovery, building Go CLI and running tests/vet/race. Remote has no tags or releases, so establish version0.1.0 and tag v0.1.0 only after coherent commit and positive build/install proof. Preserve unrelated dirty config.go schema-comment hunk.
